subject: Reserved commit pricing + single-tenant isolation surcharge clarification
messages:
From: Claire Hu <claire.hu@stormscale.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@stormscale.com
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Reserved GPU commit — single-tenant surcharge questions

Hi Sean / Monica,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — StormScale's infra and security teams liked the throughput profile you showed. Before we surface internal budget, a couple of concrete asks from procurement and security: 

- Can you confirm pricing for a 24-slot reserved GPU pool (A100-equivalent) with a 3-year commit? We want line-item pricing (monthly effective rate + up-front commit).
- We intend to require single-tenant isolation (private VPC + tenant-dedicated hosts) and KMS-backed key management for our customer data. What is the uplift or separate line item for that vs. your standard Dedicated offering?
- Do you provide an SLA for p50/p95 latency and an SLO for throughput (tokens/sec per slot) when committing to reserved capacity? Any guarantees affect our internal cost model.
- Finally, procurement needs SOC 2 evidence and a short list of audit logs you can provide (retention and access model). We attached a short requirements list.

Attached: StormScale_Request_Requirements.pdf (pdf)

Can you send a preliminary commercial that we can review with finance this week?

Best,
Claire Hu
Head of Infrastructure
StormScale

From: sean.gallagher@redwood.com <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Claire Hu <claire.hu@stormscale.com>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@stormscale.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reserved GPU commit — single-tenant surcharge questions

Claire — thanks for the clear asks and for sharing the requirements doc. Quick answers up front, then I'll loop in finance/CS for final numbers: 

1) 24-slot reserved pool, 3-year commit: we can do a stepped pricing schedule with an effective monthly commitment rate and an optional one-time onboarding credit. I'll attach a starter quote in the next email.

2) Single-tenant isolation & KMS: this is an add-on that covers dedicated host reservation and customer-managed KMS integration. Typical uplift ranges from 18%–28% depending on the strictness of the isolation controls (network egress restrictions, physical host pinning, additional audit export). For a 3-year commit we can compress that range — I recommend we propose a 20% uplift as a starting point and I can advocate for deeper discount if we get a larger commit or a case study agreement.

3) Throughput guarantees / SLOs: for reserved capacity we commit to a throughput floor per slot (tokens/sec baseline) and an availability SLA. Exact p50/p95 latency guarantees are tied to sequence-length and KV-cache configuration; we provide runbook-level guarantees in the contract (and can include an SLA credits schedule).

4) SOC 2 & audit logs: we can provide SOC 2 Type II report redacted, and exportable audit logs (auth events, API request traces, model version used) with configurable retention — default 90 days, ext. retention available as an add-on.

I'll pull together a one-page commercial summary and a quoted PDF. Monica / Marcus — pinging you both for recommended starting discount and whether we should propose the 20% isolation uplift or present a tiered option (20% / 15% for 5-year commit).

Thanks — will follow up shortly with the quote.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: monica.patel@redwood.com <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, Claire Hu <claire.hu@stormscale.com>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@stormscale.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reserved GPU commit — single-tenant surcharge questions

Quick internal note + suggested commercial posture: 

- For 24 slots, 3-year: base monthly list rate = $72,000/month (pre-discount) — this assumes A100-equivalent performance per slot.
- We can offer a 22% volume discount on base list for a 3-year commit (effective $56,160/month). That should be attractive but preserves margin.
- Single-tenant isolation uplift: present as a separate charge at 18% of discounted base (not list) — that nets $10,109/month additional. Justify as (host pinning + network egress lock + dedicated audit pipeline).
- Optional: 1-month onboarding credit if they sign within 30 days; 2% case-study reduction in year-2 if they permit a co-marketing case study.

Marcus — finance needs the blended gross margin at the proposed pricing (include KMS uplift). Marcus?

Monica
VP, Go-to-Market Operations
Redwood Inference

From: marcus.lin@redwood.com <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: monica.patel@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: Claire Hu <claire.hu@stormscale.com>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@stormscale.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reserved GPU commit — single-tenant surcharge questions

Numbers look reasonable. Running quick margin calc: 

- Discounted base: $56,160/mo
- Isolation uplift (18% of discounted base): $10,108.80/mo
- Total effective: $66,268.80/mo -> annual ~$795,225.6

Estimated gross margin at current infra pricing + ops premium: ~42% (with our assumed amortized host cost for pinned hosts). If StormScale pushes for 15% uplift we fall to ~39%. If they want deeper discount on base (<20%) we need either a longer commit or a case study to preserve margin.

Operational asks: require SOC 2 Type II and KMS integration window of 6–8 weeks for key provisioning and verification.

If Sean wants to be aggressive: offer 20% discount on base instead of 22% but drop onboarding credit — that buys flexibility in negotiations.

Marcus
Head of Finance Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Becker <tom.becker@stormscale.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reserved GPU commit — single-tenant surcharge questions

Sean / Monica — appreciate the fast turnaround. A few follow-ups from procurement/security: 

- The uplift framing as a percentage is fine, but procurement prefers a separate line item for "Isolation & KMS" so we can route to compliance budget. Can you provide a quoted monthly line item and a one-time onboarding/setup fee (we expect separate costs for host pinning and KMS onboarding).
- SOC 2 Type II redacted report works; we also need a short template for the audit log export (schema + retention controls).
- Can you do a 2-week sign window for the onboarding credit? Our budget cycle closes next Friday.

If you can send a PDF quote with line items and a DocuSign link we will route to legal.

Thanks,
Tom Becker
Director, Procurement
StormScale
